title: Job in Seat cover
text:
Job in Seat cover. This seat cover is good and very easy to install with minimum effort. All you do is just put it on one end and stretch over the seat for it the cover the seat. It does its' job in covering the seat. However, i wouldn't say it is water resistant.

I got the cover as I wanted to keep my seat from getting dirty and dusty, however, it only seems like it is protecting it but only it is just a cover on the surface. In the beginning I thought it was a wonderful and great seat cover. However, I went to pull it off a month later, dust and water collected onto the seat.. The dust and water go through the cover onto the seat as it is netted and you can clearly see through it if you stretch it.

Only does its job in covering the seat so it looks clean. Doesn't stop dust or water from going through.
